claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Amkor 的 10-Q／10-K 或法說寫出與 NVIDIA 的預付協議縮減、終止或預付款退回，或南韓擴產延後。核查頻率：每季（Amkor 10-Q 與法說）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或降 confidence，重讀先進封裝層讀圖。
claims.statement: Amkor's own release: a new USD 1.3 billion agreement with NVIDIA supports further capacity expansion in South Korea; Amkor's multi-year agreements with NVIDIA in Arizona and South Korea now total USD 3 billion, and 'the prepayments' align Amkor's capacity with NVIDIA's long-term plans — customer prepayments into OSAT packaging capacity. The release does not name the package type; NVIDIA's same-day release says interposer wafer capacity (+300% by end-2028). The USD figures are dated context in the quotes, not graph attributes (L4).

source_doc.title: Amkor Technology 新聞稿（Business Wire，2026-10-21）：Amkor Technology and NVIDIA Advance Strategic Partnership for AI Infrastructure——南韓新增 13 億美元協議，與 NVIDIA 的多年協議（亞利桑那＋南韓）合計 30 億美元，含預付款

sources.quote: New $1.3 billion agreement supports further expansion in South Korea, building on the companies' recent Arizona collaboration

today announced additional investments in South Korea for capacity expansion initiatives with NVIDIA. With this latest commitment, Amkor's multi-year agreements with NVIDIA in Arizona and South Korea total $3 billion.
The prepayments align Amkor's manufacturing capacity with NVIDIA's long-term growth plans and support increasing demand for advanced packaging solutions.
Amkor Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMKR), a leading provider of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services
